correctness.rationale: The final repaired claim is stack(F_k)=4k for every integer k>=1, with every size-4k configuration reaching the hub. From outer counts (a_i,b_i), direct-to-hub preprocessing leaves S<=2r odd residues and H=(4k+c(h)-S)/2>=2k-r>=r; if H>=r+1 one hub-assisted elimination per residual pair consumes one hub pebble. Equality forces all 2k leaves initially odd and some pair a>=3,b>=1; two internal transfers make that pair even without changing its direct-to-hub contribution, decreasing residual pairs from k to k-1. For the lower witness (2k+1,0) plus k-1 pairs (1,1), the mass ledger gives 2delta0+3A+C<=2k+1, delta0<=k and light activated delta_i<=-1. The SOURCE proof makes an invalid inference 3A+C<=1 ==> C=0; repaired RESULT.md proves C=1 impossible because A=0, B=k, one internal transfer gives both coordinates odd while total mass equation forces zero. Thus equality delta0=k implies the heavy pair retains a frozen singleton. At the last light-pair activation q=k-2 and hub>=2 forces equality, after which hub<=1 permanently; the final light pair cannot vanish without a new frozen hub pebble. k=1 triangle and threshold monotonicity for t>2k+1 finish the universal claim. Independent exact reachability from separately written exhaustive Python script checked all canonical size-4k configurations for k=1..4 (9,92,759,5265) reach hub and all stated size-(4k-1) witnesses are nonstackable. That finite work corroborates, but the analytical proof covers all k.
